name: Sahil Singh · Mac Keyboard

title.zh: Sahil Singh · 适合浏览个人前端组件与项目作

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Sahil Singh 的个人作品集，展示其作为 Design Engineer 的组件与项目。Components 页列出 Detailed Button、Password Verification、Mac Keyboard、AI Image Card、Loader Animation、Search Bar、Mac Dock、Spotify 等可预览的交互组件，每项可进入独立文档页查看预览画布与说明；Projects 页展示 Aro Music、Bookmrk、Mechanical Keyboard 等作品并附 Live link 与 GitHub 链接。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Sahil Singh (https://sahilcodex.vercel.app/).
Technology stack: react, typescript, tailwind, gsap.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
